newsitem.title: FINLAND: FORECAST - Tamro 4-month profit seen steady.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Tamro 4-month profit seen steady.

text.p: A Reuters survey of analysts covering Finnish equities showed a 71.5 million markka median forecast for Finnish pharmaceuticals wholesaler Tamro Oy's January-April profit before extraordinary items and tax.
Tamro's results are due on June 6 at 0830/0530 GMT.
In January-April 1996, Tamro posted a profit of 75 million markka.
In March, Tamro said it saw no major changes in 1997 profits compared to 1996.
The median of seven analysts' forecasts for Tamro's full-year 1997 profit before extras and tax was 230 million markka (mean 231 million) in a 203-279 million markka range.
In 1996, Tamro's profit was 224 million markka.
Contributors to the survey were Alfred Berg, AG Private Bankers, Aktia Bank, Erik Selin, Evli Securities, FIM Securities, FSB Securities, Merita Securities, Opstock Securities and Postipankki.
